definitions.explanation: An official position in government or public service. Includes elected officials, civil servants, and other positions of public trust.

examples.japanese: {公職|こうしょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{就|つ}く→就く：10123_tsuku⟧。
⟦{汚職|おしょく}→汚職：17399_oshoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{公職|こうしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{追|お}われた→追う：02016_ou⟧。
examples.english: They were removed from public office due to corruption.

examples.japanese: {公職|こうしょく}{選挙法|せんきょほう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{選挙|せんきょ}{運動|うんどう}→選挙運動：26087_senkyoundou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ルール→ルール：00354_ruuru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{細|こま}かく→細かい：01245_komakai⟧⟦{定|さだ}められている→定める：10448_sadameru⟧。
examples.english: The Public Offices Election Act sets out detailed rules for campaign activities.

notes: Composed of {公|こう} (public) + ⟦{職|しょく}→職：00376_shoku⟧ (position, office). A formal term used in legal and political contexts. Common collocations: {公職|こうしょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{就|つ}く→就く：10123_tsuku⟧ (to assume public office), {公職|こうしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{辞|じ}する (to resign from public office), {公職|こうしょく}⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧ (public office election), {公職|こうしょく}⟦{追放|ついほう}→追放：14313_tsuihou⟧ (purge from public office). The {公職|こうしょく}{選挙法|せんきょほう} (Public Offices Election Act) is a key Japanese law governing all aspects of elections. After WWII, the {公職|こうしょく}⟦{追放|ついほう}→追放：14313_tsuihou⟧ (public office purge) barred wartime leaders from government positions.
